description.html: A compressed coconut coir block is an economical solution for owners of larger terrariums or for anyone who changes substrate regularly. After soaking in water, the block expands to about 70 liters of quality coconut coir. Just put the block in a large container, pour warm water over it and wait 20-30 minutes for it to fully expand. Coconut coir holds moisture very well, is naturally resistant to mold and is safe for reptiles. It is suitable for all tropical and forest species that need higher humidity - crested geckos, chameleons, day geckos, snakes from tropical regions and many frog species. The large volume after expansion makes it far more cost-effective than smaller ready-to-use packs.
